references.text: Moses calls heaven and earth to witness that the Israelites will perish if they turn away from the Lord, the same warning as in this verse.
A warning against following other gods, with the threat of being wiped out from the face of the earth if they do so.
A parallel warning to guard their hearts so they are not led astray into worshiping other gods, with the consequence that they will quickly perish.
Describes the curse and destruction that will come upon them if they abandon the Lord.
Moses warns that they will perish if they turn away and worship other gods.
Joshua repeats the warning that they will quickly perish if they break the covenant and serve other gods.
Solomon is warned that if he or his sons turn away from the Lord and worship other gods, Israel will be cut off from the land.
Jeremiah warns against following other gods, which will lead to disaster.
